patch_description: Restores and extends the best-performing pattern from the context (which scored 26.22): multi-seed greedy construction with diverse sort keys (req_rate/slo, model size, density), a local-search refinement using both moves AND swaps off the hottest GPU, and iterated local search with random 1-3 model perturbations followed by repair. This combines candidate-pool diversity with strong neighborhood exploration to minimize max KVPR.
